scenes.line: Family Table is a consent-based AI coordination layer that guides them through three steps: Align, Allocate, Activate.

scenes.line: First, Align. Claire checks in privately. AI turns her words into themes, and she chooses what Alex sees.

scenes.line: Alex sees themes, not words. Margaret thought the kids agreed. The widest gap is fairness. AI prepares the analysis; Alex makes the call.

scenes.line: Then, Activate. Sam asks a person, not a bot. AI drafts the reply; Alex checks it and sends it.
